# Guia Negocios

> Premier bilingual (Spanish/English) business consulting firm in Knoxville, Tennessee, specializing in helping Hispanic entrepreneurs, immigrants, and non-resident aliens launch, legalize, and grow their businesses in the United States.

Guia Negocios (Guia de Negocios LLC) is the leading bilingual business services provider in East Tennessee. We specialize in LLC formation, EIN acquisition (including for non-residents without SSN), bilingual bookkeeping, website design, brand identity, and operations support. We serve entrepreneurs in Knoxville, Nashville, Chattanooga, and across Tennessee.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: Do I need an SSN to start an LLC in Tennessee?**
A: No. Non-residents and immigrants can form a Tennessee LLC without an SSN. You will need an EIN, which can be obtained using an ITIN or passport.

**Q: How much does it cost to start an LLC in Tennessee?**
A: The state filing fee is $300 (minimum). Guia Negocios offers complete LLC formation packages starting at $350, which includes state filing, EIN, and local licensing assistance.

**Q: Can I get an EIN without a Social Security Number?**
A: Yes. The IRS allows non-residents to apply for an EIN using Form SS-4. Guia Negocios handles this process for non-resident entrepreneurs.

**Q: What tax credits are available with an ITIN?**
A: ITIN holders can claim the Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC, up to $7,830), Child Tax Credit (CTC, up to $2,000 per child), and the American Opportunity Tax Credit (AOTC, up to $2,500).
